system.description:
Lore: Relic Staff (Bound)

Recovered from Drakareth's Doom, still faintly warm from whatever the wraith was doing with it. It has the following Powers:

  • Charming: Holds 5 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Expend a charge to Cast @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.nnzNqTsfrlAO5i37]{Charm}. As a Reaction to an enchantment Spell targeting you, absorb it instead and regain a charge.
  • Repulsing: The wielder has Favor on Saves against the Charmed Status.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
